plain: The familiar privacy model where a service tells you what it will do with your data and you agree or walk away.
eli5: A long paper you have to say yes to before you can play the game.
technical: The consent regime built on disclosure plus user acceptance (privacy policies, click-through and permission prompts); contextual integrity argues against it, and the agentic-privacy report finds one-time consent cannot cover the open-ended actions of an autonomous agent.
